title: Deposit Proportional HWM Upward Adjustment
precondition: Acc 1 has $10k balance (HWM $10k); deposits additional $5,000 cash.
expected_result: Acc 1 HWM basis increases dollar-for-dollar to $15,000.00; investor deposit never taxed as profit.
actual_result: Deposit upward adjustment: HWM baseline increases dollar-for-dollar to $15000.00; deposit is never taxed as profit.
